special_traits.name: Light Sensitivity
special_traits.description:
While in Bright Light, the cloaker has
Disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The cloaker makes one Attach attack and
two Tail attacks.

actions.name: Attach
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6
+ 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the cloaker attaches to it. While the cloaker is attached, the target has the Blinded condition, and the cloaker can't make Attach attacks against other targets. In addition, the cloaker halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to try to detach the cloaker, doing so by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10
+ 3) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Moan
bonus_actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature

bonus_actions.name: in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the cloaker
bonus_actions.description: Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until

bonus_actions.name: the end of the cloaker's next turn
bonus_actions.description: Success: The target is immune to this cloaker's Moan for the next 24 hours.

bonus_actions.name: Phantasms (Recharge after a Short or Long Rest)
cloaker casts the Mirror Image spell, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability
bonus_actions.description: The spell ends early if the cloaker starts or ends its turn in Bright Light.
